title: A Court Could Pause Frontier AI
script: A court is being asked to hit pause on frontier AI. Four nonprofits are suing Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceX. They want an emergency injunction to stop next-gen models. Until companies can prove humans stay in control. The complaint cites cyberattacks, rogue warnings, and catastrophic risk admissions. The wild part? Some warnings came from the builders themselves. So now the question isn’t just can we build it. It’s should a court let it keep going?
cta: Follow AI Tested for the AI court fight.
concept: Legal showdown: gavel/stamp opening, giant defendant lineup, injunction demand, risk evidence board, courtroom cliffhanger.
